camel_example: aliyun iot GenerateFileUploadURL --region cn-hangzhou --FileSuffix bin --BizCode DEVICE_JOB_FILE
description_en: Generates the information required to upload a file to Object Storage Service (OSS)
description_zh: 调用该接口生成文件上传到OSS的信息
kebab_example: aliyun iot generate-file-upload-url --file-suffix bin --biz-code DEVICE_JOB_FILE --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateFileUploadURL

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must pass this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.

If the public instance does not have an ID value, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/267533.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The file name extension. Valid values: bin, apk, tar, gz, tar.gz, zip, and gzip
parameters.name: file_suffix

parameters.help_en:
The business scenario code to which the file belongs.

For device task files, use DEVICE_JOB_FILE
parameters.help_zh:
文件所属的业务场景编码。

设备任务文件使用DEVICE_JOB_FILE
parameters.name: biz_code

parameters.help_en:
The file name. The name cannot contain hyphens (-), periods (.), asterisks (*), forward slashes (/), number signs (#), percent signs (%), ampersands (&), at signs (@), or backslashes (). The name cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically generates a random string as the file name
parameters.help_zh:
文件名称。名称不可包含短划线（-）、英文句号（.）、星号（*）、正斜线（/）、井号（#）、百分号（%）、and（&）、at（@）、反斜线（\），长度不可超过64个字符。

如果不传入该参数，系统将为文件自动生成随机字符串作为文件名称
parameters.name: file_name

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

Data.description_en: The file upload information returned if the call was successful. For more information, see the following parameters
Data.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的文件上传信息。详情参见以下参数信息

Key.description_en: The name of the object (file) to be uploaded by calling the OSS PostObject operation, including the full path of the OSS object
Key.description_zh: 调用OSS的PostObject接口上传对象（即文件）的名称，包含OSS对象的完整路径

ObjectStorage.description_en: The object storage type. Default value: OSS

OssAccessKeyId.description_en:
The AccessKey ID of the OSS bucket owner.

This OSS bucket stores the file
OssAccessKeyId.description_zh:
OSS Bucket拥有者的AccessKey ID。

该OSS Bucket将存储文件

Policy.description_en: The parameter used by OSS to verify the validity of the request form fields
Policy.description_zh: OSS通过该参数验证请求表单域的合法性

Signature.description_en: The signature information calculated based on AccessKey Secret and Policy. When calling the OSS API, OSS verifies this signature information to confirm the validity of the Post request
Signature.description_zh: 根据AccessKey Secret和Policy计算出的签名信息。调用OSS API时，OSS验证该签名信息，从而确认Post请求的合法性

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
